question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list the rectors who began a rectorship from the late 1950s until the institution closed, in chronological order.
criterion: A person began a rectorship (the start of a rector's term) of the institution.
why_needs_multiple: Chín lần bổ nhiệm rector trong một chuỗi; giới hạn từ cuối thập niên 1950 để loại e8 (derived_date, 1954).

gold_events.text: Margit T. Rätzsch began her rectorship.
Alfred Göpfert assumed office as last rector.

question: Among the dated events in the timeline, summarize the departures from the rectorship (the end of a rector's term) from the late 1950s to the mid-1970s.
criterion: A rector's term ended (the end of a rectorship) at the institution.
why_needs_multiple: Chỉ các mốc kết thúc nhiệm kỳ, không kèm mốc bắt đầu cùng nhiệm kỳ (luật 3).

question: Among the dated rector appointments from the late 1950s onward, which appointment came right after Rolf Landsberg's?
criterion: A person began a rectorship of the institution.
why_needs_multiple: Cần mốc neo (Landsberg 1962) và mốc kế tiếp (Bittrich 1964).

question: Among the dated rector appointments from the late 1950s onward, which was the most recent one?
criterion: A person began a rectorship of the institution.
why_needs_multiple: Cần mốc muộn thứ hai (Fanghänel 1990) để chứng minh mốc cuối.

gold_events.text: Alfred Göpfert assumed office as last rector.

label: institute opening
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, summarize the openings of the institutes whose names begin with 'Institute of Chemistry and Technology of'.
criterion: An institute whose name begins 'Institute of Chemistry and Technology of' opened.
why_needs_multiple: Ba viện cùng nhóm tên, mở ở ba năm khác nhau.

gold_events.text: Institute of Chemistry and Technology of Polymers opened.
Institute of Chemistry and Technology of Mineral Salts opened.
Institute of Chemistry and Technology of Fundamental and Intermediate Organic Chemical Products opened.

label: unit opening
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list the non-institute units that opened (the divisions and the university library), in any order.
criterion: A division or the university library opened.
why_needs_multiple: Bốn đơn vị phi viện (ba division và thư viện) trong hai đợt mở.

gold_events.text: University library opened with about 3000 books.

label: doctorate
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list the first doctorate and the first honorary doctorate the institution awarded, in any order.
criterion: The institution awarded its first doctorate or its first honorary doctorate.
why_needs_multiple: Hai học vị đầu tiên cùng nhóm, khác nhau về loại.

gold_events.text: First doctorate awarded to Hans-Jürgen Papenfuß.
First honorary doctorate awarded to H. H. Franck.

label: promotion rights
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list the faculties that were awarded full promotion and habilitation rights, in chronological order.
criterion: A faculty was awarded full promotion and habilitation rights.
why_needs_multiple: Ba khoa được cấp quyền promotion và habilitation ở ba thời điểm.

gold_events.text: Faculty for Material Sciences awarded full promotion and habilitation rights.
Faculty for Process Engineering and Fundamental Sciences awarded full rights.
Faculty for Engineering Economics awarded full rights.

label: institute split or merger
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list the reorganisation events in which an institute was divided into two or formed by merging existing institutes, in any order.
criterion: An existing institute was divided into two, or an institute was formed by merging existing institutes.
why_needs_multiple: Một lần tách và hai lần hợp nhất; mỗi lần là một sự kiện riêng.

gold_events.text: Institute of Technical Physics divided into two institutes.
Institute of Petroleum Chemistry and Organic Intermediates formed by merger.
Institute of Anorganic and Technical Chemistry formed by merger.

label: section formation
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list the sections formed from the early to the mid 1970s, in any order.
criterion: A section of the institution was newly formed.
why_needs_multiple: Bốn section mới trong hai đợt cải tổ 1972 và 1976; đợt cuối thập niên 1960 nằm ngoài khoảng.

gold_events.text: Mathematics and Computing Technology section formed.

question: How many years, counted by calendar year, separated the institution founding from the legal stipulation of its closure?
